claim: "SERVPRO of Old Bridge / Cranbury" (Restoration) is included
problem: Excluded type: SERVPRO is a national franchise brand. The mapper's own note says it was 'included, flagged for triage on the chain rule', so an excluded type knowingly remains. Company pages confirm it is a locally owned SERVPRO franchise territory, not an independent firm.
fix: Remove the entry, or have the orchestrator explicitly override the chain/franchise rule in writing before any BD time is spent.

claim: "ASP - America's Swimming Pool Company of Middlesex County" (Pool service) is included
problem: Excluded type: America's Swimming Pool Company is a national franchise brand ('ASP'). The list itself flags it as borderline on the chain rule, i.e. an excluded type is still in the list.
fix: Remove the entry; replace with an independent pool servicer from the same category (e.g. a verified Old Bridge operator) if coverage is thin.

claim: "Gary Dominicus & Son" is an Old Bridge plumber at 646 NJ-18 Ste 105D
problem: Contradicted. The BestProsInTown page for this firm (filed under Helmetta) gives the location as 646 NJ-18 Ste 105D, East Brunswick, NJ 08816, and the same building/suite range appears in East Brunswick listings for other firms. BBB lists the company in Helmetta. It is not an Old Bridge business, so the town field and the 'map listing in Old Bridge' evidence are both wrong.
fix: Change town to East Brunswick (or Helmetta, per BBB) and re-qualify against the zone rule, or drop the entry.

claim: "C&R Inspired Landscaping" is an Old Bridge business
problem: Contradicted. HomeAdvisor lists the company at 4 Orion Court, Matawan, NJ 07747, and its own site markets 'the Matawan area'; the Old Bridge entry carries no service-area qualifier. Old Bridge is service area only, not base town.
fix: Relabel town as 'Matawan (service area Old Bridge)' like the other service-area entries, or drop it.

claim: "Old Bridge Towing" (oldbridgetowing.us) is a local towing business
problem: Not a business. The cited page describes itself as a 'dependable towing network' of unnamed providers with one call-back number and no company name, address or operator. It is a lead-capture site, so the entry cannot be worked as an account.
fix: Remove, or replace with an actual licensed Old Bridge tow operator confirmed from a company-owned page.

claim: "American Tire & Auto Care", 2302 County Rd 516, Old Bridge
problem: Chain plus stale phone. americantires.net/locations/ lists 8 New Jersey stores under one brand (Bordentown, Chester, Flemington, Green Brook, Mercerville, North Brunswick, Old Bridge, Westfield) - a multi-store retail chain, not an independent shop. The Old Bridge store page also gives (732) 210-6444, not the (732) 679-6800 in the list.
fix: Drop under the chain rule (or get an explicit override) and correct the phone if kept.

claim: "Windows, Siding and Roofing in Old Bridge", 3171 Route 9, North Street Ste 382
problem: Identity unverifiable. The name is a keyword string, not a trading name; the only evidence is a 3-review bestprosintown page at a suite in a multi-tenant office building (other list entries use suites 309/319 at the same address). No independent website or owner name exists in any source I opened.
fix: Find the real trading name/owner or delete the row; do not count it as a distinct prospect.

claim: Coverage of Old Bridge trades is complete enough to work from
problem: Several clearly eligible Old Bridge businesses surfaced in my own category searches but are absent: White Rock Corp (roofing, 17 Gramercy Rd), Highline Painting (painters, 'based in Old Bridge' per its own site), Giglios Sewer & Drain (8 Dumas Rd), plus Directory-only entries Arbe Landscaping and Brewster Landscaping.
fix: Add these before outreach; the gap pattern is roofers, painters and septic/sewer firms, so re-run those three categories.

problem: Many rows carry 'Unknown' even where the source states an address: Zona Roofing (179 Goldmine Ln), Arctic Air Conditioning (1 Pleasant Valley Rd), Sodano Contracting (1816 Englishtown Rd, Ste 100), Bob Zeffiro & Sons (site phone 732-306-4250 not recorded).
fix: Backfill addresses/phones from the pages already cited; Unknown fields weaken mail-merge and call prep.

problem: Activity looks fine (bestprosintown shows 45 reviews, newest July 2026) but the phone is unverified: a business-record listing gives (732) 251-4900 at 1201 Englishtown Rd and one directory marks it permanently closed. The 334-0648 number came only from a bulk Cylex page.
fix: Call-verify the number or drop the phone to 'Unknown' until confirmed.

claim: "Hometown Pool Supply" and "Worldwide Flooring Design Center" are independents
problem: Borderline chain calls, not errors. Hometown Pool Supply is family-owned but runs 3 NJ stores (Old Bridge, Jackson, Toms River); Worldwide Flooring lists 4 showrooms (Edison, Lawrenceville, Fairfield, Old Bridge).
fix: Keep if the rule targets franchise/national chains; note the multi-store structure in the CRM so positioning is accurate.
